name: Warrior
overview: Scripture reveals the Lord as the ultimate Warrior, demonstrating His power and might in spiritual and physical battles, as seen in Exodus 15:3 and Isaiah 42:13. Believers are called to embody this strength, being taught by God to fight and stand firm, exemplified in Psalms 144:1 and Ephesians 6:10. The title 'mighty man of valour' in Judges 6:12 and the assurance of God's protection in Jeremiah 20:11 encourage Christians to rely on His strength to overcome adversity and prevail against enemies.
